# help removefileshare
removefileshare - Remove a fileshare from a filesystem

SYNTAX
    removefileshare [options] <filesystem_name> <share_name>

DESCRIPTION
    The removefileshare command unexports the specified fileshare in a
    filesystem which is exported to the NFS clients.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the fileshare_remove right

OPTIONS
    -d
        Remove fileshare after unexporting it. The fileshare can only be removed if
        there is no user data in the share.

    -f
        Specifies that the command is forced. If this option is not used, the
        command requires confirmation before proceeding with its operation.

SPECIFIERS
    <filesystem_name>
        Specifies a filesystem name whose share needs to be unmounted and removed.

    <share_name>
        Specifies a fileshare name up to 255 characters in length.

NOTES
    If -d option is specified and user data is present in the share, the command
    fails and fileshare will not be unexported and will not be removed as well.

    Issuing the removefileshare command with invalid filesystem name or invalid
    fileshare name causes the command to exit without unexporting and removing any fileshare.

    Verify the removal of fileshare by issuing the showfileshare command.

EXAMPLES
    The following example unmounts and removes fileshare demo_share which is part
    of filesystem demo_fs

       cli% removefileshare -d demo_fs demo_share

    The following example unexports fileshare demo_share which is part of filesystem demo_fs

       cli% removefileshare demo_fs demo_share
